message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability in the last 24 hours was verified as a direct match to a component or version in `DLL_software_component.txt`. The mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep identified one fresh MongoDB Compass vulnerability that warrants review if Compass is deployed.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-23 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-24 07:40 UTC (2026-10-23 13:10 IST through 2026-10-24 13:10 IST).

### MongoDB Compass certificate-validation vulnerability

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Compass before 1.53.1
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-115929; related Electron mitigation CVE-2026-115570
- **Severity:** CVE-2026-115929 is High under CVSS 4.0 (7.6) and Medium under CVSS 3.1 (6.8). The underlying Electron advisory is High (7.4).
- **Description:** Compass used an Electron TLS root certificate store containing recoverable eMudhra intermediate CA certificates, creating a risk that certificates issued from those intermediates could be trusted. MongoDB resolved the issue in Compass 1.53.1 by updating Electron to 44.9.1.
- **Why relevant:** This was found by the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep. MongoDB Compass is not named in the DLL component inventory, so deployment applicability must be confirmed rather than assumed.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Compass 1.53.1 release](https://github.com/mongodb-js/compass/releases/tag/v1.53.1), [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-115929), [GitHub Advisory Database: Electron](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, maintained libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, CISA sources, and credible security reporting. No other in-window MongoDB finding was verified.

### Review priority

No immediate action is indicated for the listed DLL inventory based on newly reported issues in this window. Confirm whether MongoDB Compass is deployed; if so, review systems running versions before 1.53.1 promptly.
